Description

The Xiaomi Redmi Note 15 Pro+ 5G is the flagship model in the Redmi Note 15 series, launched globally in January 2026. Positioned as a "mid-range rocket," it features a significant battery upgrade and enhanced durability, often marketed with the "Titan Durability" tagline.

 

Key Specifications

  • Performance: Powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 (4nm) processor with up to 12GB RAM and 512GB internal storage.
  • Display: A 6.83-inch 1.5K CrystalRes AMOLED screen with a 120Hz refresh rate and a peak brightness of 3,200 nits.
  • Camera: Features a 200MP main camera with Optical Image Stabilization (OIS), an 8MP ultra-wide lens, and a 32MP front camera.
  • Battery & Charging: Equipped with a massive 6,500mAh battery (a 1,390mAh increase over its predecessor) that supports 100W HyperCharge, reaching 100% in roughly 40 minutes.
  • Durability: Protected by Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 and holds an IP69K rating, making it highly resistant to dust and high-pressure water immersion.
  •  

Notable Features

  • Offline Communication: Supports device-to-device voice calls without network coverage in certain regions.
  • AI Integration: Features Google Gemini and "Circle to Search," along with Xiaomi's AI Interpreter and AI Writing tools.
  • Software: Runs on Xiaomi HyperOS 2 (based on Android 15).
